'''Ertegas''' was an [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] located in the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was run by a populace of [[Agrirobot/Legends|agri-droids]] overseen by a small number of [[Human/Legends|Humans]], and the future [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Bespin Wing Guard]] [[Police officer/Legends|member]] [[Allen Neff]] [[Homeworld/Legends|hailed]] from the [[Planet/Legends|world]].

==Description==
Ertegas was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Ertegas system/Legends|Ertegas system]], a part of the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]]. It was situated in the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]] region within the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The world lay on the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] known as the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]], which connected it to the [[Darlyn Boda system/Legends|Darlyn Boda system]] and the neighboring [[Yarith sector/Legends|Yarith sector's]] [[Shuxl system/Legends|Shuxl system]]. Ertegas was located inside the [[Ivax Nebula/Legends|Ivax Nebula]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
After the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] victory in a [[Galactic Republic–Mugaari war|war]] against the nearby civilization of the [[Mugaari]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="GG">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040325web|text=Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin|int=Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin}}</ref> at some point between approximately [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] and [[600 BBY/Legends|600 BBY]],<ref name="MugaariDate">{{RepublicMugaariWarDate}}</ref> the former established the [[Javin sector/Legends|Javin sector]] in the former [[Mugaari Space/Legends|Mugaari Space]].<ref name="GG" /> Around [[400 BBY/Legends|400 BBY]],<ref name="SectorDates" /> the portion of the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] containing Ertegas was re-designated as the Anoat sector.<ref name="GG" /> Ertegas was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Allen Neff]],<ref name="Insider148">{{InsiderCite|148|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: The Cloud City Wing Guards}}</ref> who was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] at some point by [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]]<ref name="3 BBY">{{InsiderCite|148|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: The Cloud City Wing Guards}} states [[Allen Neff]] arrived to [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] at the age of six and eventually became a member of the [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Bespin Wing Guard]]. "Rogues Gallery" also depicts Neff serving in the ranks of the Wing Guard during the events of {{Film|V}}, which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. Therefore, Neff must have been [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] at some point by [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]].</ref> and eventually became a [[Police officer/Legends|member]] of the [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Bespin Wing Guard]] [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|security force]] on<ref name="Insider148" /> the Anoat sector planet [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Inhabitants==
Ertegas was a thriving [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]]<ref name="TEA" /> that was almost entirely automated,<ref name="GG" /> being run by<ref name="TEA" /> [[Agrirobot/Legends|agri-droids]]<ref name="GG" /> that were supervised by a handful of Human overseers.<ref name="TEA" /> Rumors claimed that the world's [[Droid/Legends|droid]] populace had in fact taken over control a long [[Time/Legends|time]] prior, with the Human authority reduced to being purely formal.<ref name="GG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ertegas was introduced in [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' supplement "[[Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin]]," which was published on [[Wizards.com]] on [[March 25]], [[2004]].<ref name="GG" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the world in grid square K-18.<ref name="TEA" />
